explicit_negation.meaning: Negative support is first-class evidence and does not erase positive support.
explicit_negation.conflict: Positive and negative support together yield BOTH. Rule order cannot choose a winner.

default_negation.succeeds_when: positive support is absent in the completed lower stratum
default_negation.stability_rule: Default negation is evaluated only after the referenced lower stratum reaches its fixpoint.

rules: FactDelta(+1) inserts one named derivation support; FactDelta(-1) removes only that named support.
Repeating the same derivation identity with byte-identical content is an idempotent duplicate, not multiplicity.
A proposition remains present while at least one derivation support remains.
Removing the final support emits a retraction into the affected reverse dependency closure.
Support count underflow, an unknown derivation target, or same derivation identity with different content is a typed conflict.

stratification.positive_recursion: allowed within a stratum under a bounded least-fixpoint worklist
stratification.negative_dependency: must point strictly to a lower stratum
stratification.worklist_order: deterministic tie-break by canonical rule id then canonical tuple bytes

logical_time.frontier_rule: Epoch t may publish only when the low watermark is strictly greater than t.
logical_time.late_event_policy: A late event must produce a declared correction, retraction, rejection, or compensation; it cannot silently rewrite a published effect.

outside_v0: automatic rollback of an external effect
